name: Button
summary: A themed native button with consistent action hierarchy and pending feedback.

props.name: variant
props.meaning: Action emphasis; defaults to primary. Danger uses semantic error tokens.

props.name: loading
props.meaning: Disables interaction, exposes aria-busy and adds a decorative spinner without replacing the accessible name.

props.name: type
props.meaning: Defaults to button. Forms must explicitly use submit.

props.name: native button props
props.meaning: Forwards native handlers, disabled state, ARIA attributes, ref and children.

accessibility: Native keyboard semantics, visible focus and a stable accessible name. Theme text and background colors change together to retain contrast; only borders transition. Loading disables repeated activation and sets aria-busy; reduced motion stops the spinner.
usage: Use primary for a form's main action, secondary for alternatives, ghost for row actions and danger for consequential actions. Set loading from the actual pending operation.

examples.label: Action hierarchy
examples.description: Button variants and pending feedback; no request or account change.
